name: global-registry
description: Provider-neutral infrastructure control plane on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.dev: node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && wrangler dev --local --env development --config wrangler.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm deploy:preflight && node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.operator.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run:local: node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && node scripts/deployment-preflight.mjs --local --config wrangler.jsonc && node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --env development
scripts.deploy: pnpm deploy:preflight && node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.operator.jsonc
scripts.startup:check: node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && wrangler check startup --env development --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check:migrations: node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && tsx scripts/check-migrations.ts && tsx scripts/check-migrations-regressions.ts
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && eslint src test scripts
scripts.check: pnpm check:typescript-containment && pnpm check:typescript-containment-regressions && pnpm check:deployment-preflight && pnpm check:validate-export && pnpm check:local-auth && pnpm types && pnpm types:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:domain-boundary && pnpm check:test-classification && pnpm check:migrations && pnpm check:openapi && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env development --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm deploy:preflight && node scripts/check-typescript-containment.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.operator.jsonc
